names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Κλαύδιος ο Τριβούνος, Ιλαρία η σύζυγος του και τα παιδιά τους Ιάσων και Μαύρος», with the rank word left off. His own heading on the life page is «Αγιος Μαυρος ο Υιος Του Αγιου Κλαυδιου Του Τριβουνου».

Read out of the name link behind this saint's place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 19 марта ст. ст., «Мавр Римский, мч.», with the rank word left off. The day's own line declines the name and gives no city.

death.note: saint.gr dates his father's office and not the beheading: «Ο Κλαύδιος ήταν Τριβούνος στο αξίωμα στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Νουμεριανου (283 - 284 μ.Χ.)». The reign is the interval the page prints, and it is the same interval the corpus holds for his father and mother.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 марта ст. ст. — «Мчч. Хрисанфа и Дарии и с ними мчч. Клавдия трибуна, Иларии, жены его, Иасона и Мавра, сынов их, Диодора пресвитера и Мариана диакона (283).»

attestations.note: The line names him among «Иасона и Мавра, сынов их», and the life has the sons beheaded with their father's soldiers. The line enumerates all eight of the company by name and closes «(283)», the year this folder already held, and the life page behind it puts the executions under Numerian, «(283 - 284)», which is the interval the corpus already records for the companions. The eight name links are the only place this calendar gives the by-name Римский, which the day's own declined line does not. The day page prints no hymn for any of the eight.

Not checked whether doxologia.ro's calendar names him in his own right (30 September 2026). Its life of Claudius, already read for that folder, mentions two sons and does not name them in its calendar line.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Κλαύδιος ο Τριβούνος, Ιλαρία η σύζυγος του και τα παιδιά τους Ιάσων και Μαύρος»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The day's line names him, and the life page gives him a heading of his own and a couplet shared with his brother, «Εις τους Μαύρον και Ιάσων», which is why he is kept as a folder rather than as a clause in his father's life.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 01.04.2026 (19. март ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Хрисант и Дарија, и други с њима.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the other calendars already keep in these folders, and the same company: Rome, the reign of Numerian, the torturer who was converted by what he saw and died with his household, and Chrysanthus and Daria buried alive under stones. The heading names two and then „и други с њима“, and the body names three more — Claudius, Diodorus the priest and Marianus the deacon — and describes, without naming, Claudius's wife and his two sons. All eight folders the corpus already holds on this day take a row, which is how the rows already in them were written: saint.gr's own line for this family names all four of them together, and its line for the clergy names the other two. The Prologue's „283. и 284. године“ is the pair of years these folders already hold, so no date was touched. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. **No Serbian name form was stored for this saint.** The Prologue does not name her or him at all: the heading reaches this folder through „и други с њима“, and the body says only that Claudius's wife said a prayer and breathed her last at the place of execution and that his two sons were beheaded. A form taken from another calendar and spelt Serbian would be one this corpus composed.
